# no-style-please

Source: https://github.com/riggraz/no-style-please
Pinned commit: 2f8dba2c23633b21e45dce0fe2e34ec2d79bb1ca
License: MIT, see LICENSE.txt in this directory.

The theme is vendored, not fetched by Jekyll. Its stylesheet lives in
`_sass/no-style-please.scss`, with the inversion-based theme switcher removed.
The default, home, page, post, head, back-link and post-list templates are adapted
locally in `_layouts` and `_includes`. The local customization is in
`assets/css/main.scss`: permanent dark bluish colors, Fira Sans, responsive post
previews, pagination and article typography. No remote CSS, theme gem, KaTeX,
analytics or theme JavaScript is loaded.
